note: Lever: gated attention (Muse Glimmer's self_attn.gate_proj -- a sigmoid gate on the attention output before o_proj). First arm measured at the GOOD operating point (LR 3e-4 + warmup 14, TGT 6.2030) rather than the distorted LR6e-4/warmup2 point the first four arch arms used. That matters: arch effects can interact with the optimiser regime, and e05/e07/e08/e09 were all judged 0.225 away from achievable. Their verdicts survive because their margins were 0.24-0.35, but ReLU^2's TIE is close enough to flip and will be re-tested here too.
